references.name: John Maynard Keynes
references.connection:
Aggregate demand, animal spirits,

references.connection:
Monetarism, natural rate hypothesis,

references.connection:
Coase theorem — private bargaining

references.name: Paul Volcker
references.connection:

    credibility matters

references.name: John Nash
references.connection:
Nash equilibrium — game theory

references.name: Irving Fisher
references.connection:
Fisher effect — nominal interest

references.connection:
Nutrition’s role in economic

references.name: Michael Kremer
references.connection:

references.connection:
Population growth would outstrip food
